'''Kaycee Kollenz''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Freighter tramper/Legends|freighter tramper]]<ref name="DAG" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Kollenz traveled aboard<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> the [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]]-carrying [[AA-9 Coruscant freighter/Legends|AA-9 Coruscant freighter]] ''[[Jendirian Valley/Legends|Jendirian Valley]]'',<ref name="DB">{{DB|starship|starfreighter|starfreighter}}</ref> as it traveled from<ref name="AOTC" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to<ref name="AOTC" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="AOTC" /> During the voyage, Kollenz sat near [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who were both disguised as refugees. While aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]],<ref name="AOTC" /> the freighter tramper wore a [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] with yellow markings that connected to a freighter travelers [[Breath mask/Legends|breathing apparatus]]. Kollenz had brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and tan skin.<ref name="DAG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kaycee Kollenz first appeared, unnamed, in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. The scenes with the character, who was portrayed by an uncredited actor, were filmed at building 48 of [[Fox Studios, Sydney]].<ref name="365Days">''[[Creating the Worlds of Star Wars: 365 Days]]''</ref> Kollenz is visible in the background of a scene where Amidala wakes Skywalker up from a bad dream, though the sequence was ultimately not included in the released film.<ref name="Nightmare">{{Film|II}} &#x2014; Deleted Scene: Anakin's Nightmare</ref> Before Episode II's release, the character was first revealed in the web documentary "[[Making Episode II Webdocs|A Twinkle Beyond Pluto]],"<ref name="ATBP">{{SW|url=video/a-twinkle-beyond-pluto|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 5: A Twinkle Beyond Pluto}}</ref> released on [[July 31]], [[2001]].<ref name="ATBP Date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/me2/archive.html|text=''Making Episode II Webdocs'' archive}}</ref> Kollenz was later first identified in the [[2005]] reference book ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'', written by [[Trisha Biggar]].<ref name="DAG" />
